messages:
hannah: Quick flag from partner: after a vendor image bumped the NVIDIA driver to 542.6 they saw intermittent `cuLaunchKernel` failures and throughput drop on H100s. They asked if we can pin the marketplace listing while we investigate.

oz: Can you paste a short log snippet and which model/batches? Also is this only H100?

hannah: Partner snippet (redacted):
```
[2026-03-21T11:02:03Z] worker ERROR: cuLaunchKernel failed: invalid device function
[2026-03-21T11:02:03Z] runtime WARN: kernel fell back to safe path; latency increased
[2026-03-21T11:02:03Z] worker ERROR: inference error: cudaErrorIllegalAddress
```
Model: quantized 7B family, batch 2-6. Repro on our H100 infra; A100 unaffected.

marc: Short term: we can scope a per-listing driver pin to 540.2 and add an immediate rollback toggle in marketplace config. That limits blast radius.

oz: I'll coordinate the pin and canary rollout. marketplace-bot: queued action -> set driver_pin=540.2 for listing 'partner-x-llm' (scoped). ETA ~3h for canary.

hannah: Thanks. Eng-runtime: can you add a guarded fallback in the runtime to avoid fused-kernel fast-paths on drivers >=542 until we rebuild kernels? If yes, please open a small PR and set ETA.

marc: Will do. I'll open PR `fix/guard-fused-kernels-driver-542` with a driver check + safe fallback (ETA 36h). Also adding a tiny smoke script for marketplace gating.

hannah: Action summary: oz -> pin+canary (ETA 3h), marc -> runtime PR (ETA 36h), hannah -> partner comms (ETA 1h). Keep updates here, no public announcement until partner signoff. :thumbsup:
